ops.text:
`go test ./internal/cli/` hangs for the full 600s timeout on a dev machine that has the real `gt` (Graphite CLI) installed.

`TestShipGateKeepsOwnRepo` (internal/cli/lane_test.go:122) drives `runShipCmd` down the graphite lane, which reaches `shipCommitGT` → `shipGTAdd` (internal/cli/shipgt.go:262) → `render.RunCLI(ctx, "gt", ...)`. That call blocks in `os/exec` `wait4` forever — the real `/opt/homebrew/bin/gt` is invoked instead of the test's fake, and it never returns (auth or network prompt, presumably).

Reproduced identically on an untouched worktree at 4e51211, so it is not a regression from any in-flight work. CI stays green because `gt` isn't installed on the runner, so the live-test skip fires there — the hang is invisible to CI and only bites locally.

Cost: every full `task test` run on this machine burns 10 minutes and ends in a red FAIL that has to be manually recognized as environmental before you can trust the rest of the suite.

Likely fix: `setupShipGT`'s fake needs to shadow `gt` on PATH for this test the way the other lane tests do, or the test needs the same "bin not installed / bin IS installed" gate the shiplive tests use (internal/cli/shiplive_test.go:45).
